inputs.text: Public office is a trust, not a licence to gamble with taxpayers’ money. The court found Mary Ngechi Ngethe played a central role in acquiring unsuitable cemetery land at a cost of Ksh.283 million. Families who work hard and pay their taxes should not be made to carry the cost of such failures. Recovering the money and holding officials accountable are basic duties of government—and necessary to preserve public trust.
